 🔹 Perform manual testing of conversational AI applications and end to end customer journeys

 🔹 Test AI safety, prompt injection vulnerabilities and inappropriate content
 🔹 Investigate issues using Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery and PostgreSQL
 🔹 Perform functional, regression and smoke testing
 🔹 Document defects and collaborate with AI developers and product teams
 What we’re looking for 
 ✅ 1+ year of hands on experience in manual QA testing
 ✅ Experience testing AI/ML systems, LLMs or conversational AI
 ✅ Understanding of prompt engineering, dialogue flows and probabilistic systems
 ✅ Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno
 ✅ Familiarity with GCP, BigQuery and PostgreSQL
 ✅ Knowledge of Jira, Confluence and QA methodologies
 ✅ Experience with GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools
 ✅ Good communication skills and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams
 Nice to have: German language skills.
